name: Flexygo
composeTemplate:
services:
  flexygo-frontend:
    image: flexygo/flexygo-frontend:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Development
      BackendEndpoint: http://flexygo-backend:8080/api/backend/
    volumes:
      - front-conf:/app/conf
      - front-custom:/app/custom
    networks:
      - proxy
      - default
    depends_on:
      - flexygo-backend
    labels:
      - traefik.enable=true
      - traefik.docker.network=proxy
      - traefik.http.routers.${APP_SUBDOMAIN}.rule=Host(`${APP_SUBDOMAIN}.${BASE_DOMAIN}`)
      - traefik.http.services.${APP_SUBDOMAIN}.loadbalancer.server.port=8080
  flexygo-backend:
    image: flexygo/flexygo-backend:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT: Development
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${SQL_PASSWORD}
      FrontendEndpoint: http://flexygo-frontend:8080
      ConnectionStrings__ConfConnectionString: Server=flexygo-db;Integrated Security=false;Initial Catalog=Flexygo_IC;User ID=sa;Password=${SQL_PASSWORD};Encrypt=False;TrustServerCertificate=True
      ConnectionStrings__DataConnectionString: Server=flexygo-db;Integrated Security=false;Initial Catalog=Flexygo_I;User ID=sa;Password=${SQL_PASSWORD};Encrypt=False;TrustServerCertificate=True
      DatabaseNuget__PackageId: Flexygo.Conf.Database
      DatabaseNuget__NugetUrl: https://nuget.ahorabh.com/v3/index.json
    volumes:
      - back-conf:/app/conf
      - back-custom:/app/custom
    extra_hosts:
      - host.docker.internal:host-gateway
    depends_on:
      flexygo-db:
        condition: service_healthy
  flexygo-db:
    image: flexygo/flexygo-db:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ACCEPT_EULA: "Y"
      MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD: ${SQL_PASSWORD}
      MSSQL_PID: Express
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/opt/mssql/data
      - db-log:/var/opt/mssql/log
      - db-secrets:/var/opt/mssql/secrets
volumes:
  front-conf:
  front-custom:
  back-conf:
  back-custom:
  db-data:
  db-log:
  db-secrets:
networks:
  proxy:
    external: true

envVarsSchema.label: Contraseña de la base de datos (sa): 8 caracteres o más, con mayúsculas, minúsculas y números
